en.sayed-ali-raza: One condition does not prevent Him from (getting into) another condition, time does not change Him, place does not locate him and the tongue does not describe Him.

The number of drops of water, of stars in the sky, or of currents of winds in the air are not unknown to Him, nor the movements of ants on rocks, or the resting place of grubs in the dark night. He knows the places where leaves fall, and the secret movements of the pupils of the eyes.
